body.name: Sun
body.radiusDefinition: IAU 2015 nominal solar radius; a reference conversion constant, not an exact measured radius.
body.temperatureDefinition: IAU 2015 nominal effective temperature; a reference conversion constant, not a surface temperature map.

geometry.orientation: +Y north; +Z longitude zero; +X longitude 90 degrees east
geometry.longitudeReference: Illustrative asset coordinates, not a measured solar orientation.

classification: Procedural scientific illustration with a separate artistic interpretation; not a live observation or plasma simulation.

time.label: Illustration speed
time.meaning: Illustrative evolution seconds. Speed is not a calibrated solar time multiplier; catalog epoch and positions never advance.

surface.artisticScaleMeaning: Cells and sunspots are deliberately enlarged in artistic mode for whole-Sun readability; their apparent sizes are not measured solar dimensions.
surface.granulationScaleMeaning: Procedural cell frequency per normalized radius; approximate order-of-magnitude size only, not measured solar cells.
surface.rotationMeaning: Accelerated illustrative texture rotation; not a solar rotation model.
surface.spotsMeaning: Invented demonstration groups; not an observed or forecast sunspot map.

activity.meaning: Stylized plasma arches and occasional expanding ejecta in artistic mode only. Geometry follows invented active regions, not a computed magnetic field. Timing, height and flow are illustrative; this is neither observed current solar activity nor a physical plasma simulation.

scientific.label: Scientific illustration
scientific.description: Exposure-adjusted near-white photosphere with fine convection cells and illustrative filamented sunspots. Dramatic atmospheric effects are reserved for Artistic. The edge-darkening approximation is not fitted to a specified observing band.

artistic.label: Artistic interpretation
artistic.description: Warm, enlarged convection cells and sunspots, flowing plasma arches and occasional expanding eruptions. This combines visual inspiration from different solar layers; it is not a visible-light or ultraviolet observation. Motion and feature sizes are illustrative.

rendering.limbModel: I(mu)/I(1) = 1 - u * (1 - mu); mu is the cosine between the outward surface normal and view direction.
rendering.granulationFiltering: Attenuate unresolved procedural detail with pixel footprint or equivalent filtering; do not claim that unresolved whole-disc cells are measured features.
rendering.transfer: Blender nodes and the application shader are separate implementations sharing appearance parameters. Arbitrary Blender procedural graphs and compositor glow are not executable glTF payloads.

limits: Surface activity is generated, not measured.
Brightness is compressed for a display; it is not a radiometric simulation.
The linear limb-darkening approximation does not encode wavelength dependence.
Artistic glow, plasma arches and eruptions are not a physically solved corona or magnetic-field model.
Artistic cells and sunspots are deliberately enlarged; brightness is not elevation and no solar terrain map is used.
The inspection view does not update catalog positions or the historical coordinate epoch.
